exposure.statement: This independent agent task began without parent task history or findings. I read only the permitted review metadata, published contract guidance, all 30 bounded reading JSONs, cohort index/contracts/unreviewed templates, selected originals as static text, the permitted native-context inventory/sources/targets sections, and setup.md target text, plus the required RTK shell instructions. A stale cache-template provenance header failed SHA validation and was replaced with the corresponding permitted tracked unreviewed-template header; judgments stayed unchanged.
